verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.184
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.184

verses.pali: 19. Brāhmaṇavagga
verses.english: 19. Brahmins

verses.pali: Abhayasutta
verses.english: Fearless

verses.pali: Atha kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṁ sammodi.
verses.english: Then the brahmin Jānussoṇi went up to the Buddha, and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side and said to the Buddha:

verses.pali: “Ahañhi, bho gotama, evaṁvādī evaṁdiṭṭhi:
verses.english: “Worthy Gotama, this is my doctrine and view:

verses.pali: ‘natthi yo maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati, na santāsaṁ āpajjati maraṇassā’”ti.
verses.english: ‘All those liable to death are frightened and terrified of death.’”

verses.pali: “Atthi, brāhmaṇa, maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati, santāsaṁ āpajjati maraṇassa;
verses.english: “Brahmin, some of those liable to death are frightened and terrified of death.

verses.pali: atthi pana, brāhmaṇa, maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati, na santāsaṁ āpajjati maraṇassa.
verses.english: But some of those liable to death are not frightened and terrified of death.

verses.pali: Katamo ca, brāhmaṇa, maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati, santāsaṁ āpajjati maraṇassa?
verses.english: Who are those frightened of death?

verses.pali: Idha, brāhmaṇa, ekacco kāmesu avītarāgo hoti avigatacchando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho.
verses.english: It’s someone who isn’t free of greed, desire, fondness, thirst, passion, and craving for sensual pleasures.

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ aññataro gāḷho rogātaṅko phusati.
verses.english: When they fall seriously ill,

verses.pali: Tassa aññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṁ hoti:
verses.english: they think:

verses.pali: ‘piyā vata maṁ kāmā jahissanti, piye cāhaṁ kāme jahissāmī’ti.
verses.english: ‘The sensual pleasures that I love so much will leave me, and I’ll leave them.’

verses.pali: So socati kilamati paridevati, urattāḷiṁ kandati, sammohaṁ āpajjati.
verses.english: They sorrow and wail and lament, beating their breast and falling into confusion.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati, santāsaṁ āpajjati maraṇassa.
verses.english: This is someone who is frightened of death.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco kāye avītarāgo hoti avigatacchando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho.
verses.english: Furthermore, it’s someone who isn’t free of greed, desire, fondness, thirst, passion, and craving for the body.

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ aññataro gāḷho rogātaṅko phusati.
verses.english: When they fall seriously ill,

verses.pali: Tassa aññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṁ hoti:
verses.english: they think:

verses.pali: ‘piyo vata maṁ kāyo jahissati, piyañcāhaṁ kāyaṁ jahissāmī’ti.
verses.english: ‘This body that I love so much will leave me, and I’ll leave it.’

verses.pali: So socati kilamati paridevati, urattāḷiṁ kandati, sammohaṁ āpajjati.
verses.english: They sorrow and wail and lament, beating their breast and falling into confusion.

verses.pali: Ayampi kho, brāhmaṇa, maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati, santāsaṁ āpajjati maraṇassa.
verses.english: This, too, is someone who is frightened of death.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco akatakalyāṇo hoti akatakusalo akatabhīruttāṇo katapāpo kataluddo katakibbiso.
verses.english: Furthermore, it’s someone who hasn’t done good and skillful things that keep them safe, but has done bad things, violence and sin.

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ aññataro gāḷho rogātaṅko phusati.
verses.english: When they fall seriously ill,

verses.pali: Tassa aññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṁ hoti:
verses.english: they think:

verses.pali: ‘akataṁ vata me kalyāṇaṁ, akataṁ kusalaṁ, akataṁ bhīruttāṇaṁ;
verses.english: ‘Well, I haven’t done good and skillful things that keep me safe.

verses.pali: kataṁ pāpaṁ, kataṁ luddaṁ, kataṁ kibbisaṁ.
verses.english: And I have done bad things, violence and sin.

verses.pali: Yāvatā, bho, akatakalyāṇānaṁ akatakusalānaṁ akatabhīruttāṇānaṁ katapāpānaṁ kataluddānaṁ katakibbisānaṁ gati taṁ gatiṁ pecca gacchāmī’ti.
verses.english: When I depart, I’ll go to the place where people who’ve done such things go.’

verses.pali: So socati kilamati paridevati, urattāḷiṁ kandati, sammohaṁ āpajjati.
verses.english: They sorrow and wail and lament, beating their breast and falling into confusion.

verses.pali: Ayampi kho, brāhmaṇa, maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati, santāsaṁ āpajjati maraṇassa.
verses.english: This, too, is someone who is frightened of death.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco kaṅkhī hoti vicikicchī aniṭṭhaṅgato saddhamme.
verses.english: Furthermore, it’s someone who’s doubtful, uncertain, and undecided about the true teaching.

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ aññataro gāḷho rogātaṅko phusati.
verses.english: When they fall seriously ill,

verses.pali: Tassa aññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṁ hoti:
verses.english: they think:

verses.pali: ‘kaṅkhī vatamhi vicikicchī aniṭṭhaṅgato saddhamme’ti.

verses.pali: So socati kilamati paridevati, urattāḷiṁ kandati, sammohaṁ āpajjati.
verses.english: They sorrow and wail and lament, beating their breast and falling into confusion.

verses.pali: Ayampi kho, brāhmaṇa, maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati, santāsaṁ āpajjati maraṇassa.
verses.english: This, too, is someone who is frightened of death.

verses.pali: Ime kho, brāhmaṇa, cattāro maraṇadhammā samānā bhāyanti, santāsaṁ āpajjanti maraṇassa.
verses.english: These are the four individuals liable to death who are frightened and terrified of death.

verses.pali: “Abhikkantaṁ, bho gotama, abhikkantaṁ, bho gotama …pe… upāsakaṁ maṁ bhavaṁ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṁ saraṇaṁ gatan”ti.
verses.english: “Excellent, worthy Gotama! … From this day forth, may the worthy Gotama remember me as a lay follower who has gone for refuge for life.”

verses.pali: Catutthaṁ.
